question: If I were to write an isekai thing, I’d dig way too deeply into the worldbuilding, but is Mr. Cat the type to come up with details that you won’t depict and have no intention of depicting?
answer: I think about the developments coming up, so I do at least think about the bits involved with those upcoming developments, but I probably don’t think much about details that won’t be shown. That would summon the ‘Wasteful Ghost’ (note: reference to a mascot from a series of commercials urging people not to be wasteful).
